status: Qualitative predictions before full LR sweeps; timing pilots at LR=.003 have already been observed
p41_width: muP should have a more width-invariant optimal base LR than Kaiming, because its hidden LR and readout forward factor compensate width. Better transfer need not imply lower tuned loss.
p41_depth: CompleteP's 1/r branch scaling should control residual growth most strongly and plausibly transfer the base LR best; Depth-muP should improve on uncorrected muP. The five-step loss winner is not guaranteed by this argument.
p42_width: muP should transfer the best sampled width-512 LR (.003) more reliably, but fixed norm epsilon, clipping and weight decay can shift the optimum over long training.
p42_target: Numerical width-1024 predictions will be frozen using only source widths128/256/512 before submitting or examining target runs.
p42_depth: Depth corrections should limit early residual growth, but may not yield the lowest tuned loss at153.6M tokens. Both transfer and tuned performance must be measured separately.
